about: The move figures of the phones (design v3 §11) and the desktop app (slice 35), written by tools/figures/publish.py, never by hand: per library move the owner whose loops/<owner>.mp4 (HEVC, the phones'; films/<owner>.mp4, the same film in H.264, the desktop app's) and stills/<owner>.png it shows, the move itself (a timing variant's film is its own run table over its reference move's frames), the key pose's second in that film, whether the pack mirrors the move, where the owner has a fault, its caption key (`fault`: pairs/<owner>.key.png and pairs/<owner>.fault.png are its right-versus-wrong pair, slice 22; a timing variant's are its reference move's), where its loop shows more than one rep (a dead bug's two sides), the second in the film at which each rep but the last ends (counts; the last ends with the loop), and where the move has gear variants, `gear`: by equipment key the same for the figure drawn with that implement (its owner `<move>.<gear>`), which a player whose load the implement carries is shown (the core's implement with the player's gear), any other the move's own; per owner, as shares of the film's square and unmirrored, the box its figure and props fill over the whole loop (box: left, top, right, bottom, the bottom where it stands), the edges that cut its floor light (fade: left, right, bottom, null where none does) and the square a tile shows of its still (tile: x, y, side), and the film's own length in seconds (loop: its video track's samples' durations summed, its frames / 30, the same in both encodings), one loop at real tempo, the beat a rep count follows; the card the films are drawn on; the crimson (tokens.json figureCrimson) the stills are drawn in; the films' layout (film, slice 29): each film is side wide and tint + side high, the base in its top square, the tint (the cloth's light on black) in the square from row tint, shown as clamp(base + tint x colour / 255) per channel on the stored values, crimson where no game sheet names a colour; each still's and pair still's tint beside it (<name>.t.png), which takes the still drawn over the card (S; a pair still is opaque already) into a colour as clamp(S - tint x crimson + tint x colour); each file's sha256; and films_digest, the first 16 hex digits of the sha256 over a `<name> <sha256>` line per films/ file in name order, which names the desktop app's download, figures-<films_digest>.zip (each films/ file under its name here), and the folder it keeps it in. Beside the moves, `extras` names each figure that is no library move (tools/figures/motion.py `extra`; the streak card's standard-bearer, streak_banner) with its still's box, fade and tile as an owner's, read off its still: stills/<extra>.png, 960 px square, its key pose in crimson keyed as an owner's still is, with its tint stills/<extra>.t.png; an extra has no film and no loop.
